{{Quote|Since you're new here, I'll issue the standard warning. You're restricted to the civilian areas of the station. Stay away from the Red Zone. Imperials only.|Cleben, to Sacha Swiftbird|<ref name="The Last Jedi (novel)">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>}}
'''Cleben''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] corporate functionary who served as the [[stationmaster]] of [[Kantaros Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Fervse'dra]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Both system]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
In [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], Cleben greeted the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sacha Swiftbird]], the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Den Dhur]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[I-5YQ]] after they arrived on Kantaros station in disguise as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]-affiliated [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] while on a rescue mission to free [[Thi Xon Yimmon]], a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] resistance leader who was being held prisoner aboard the station. Cleben warned Swiftbird and her compatriots not to stray into the [[Red Zone]], an Imperial-controlled region of the station, and he agreed to purchase some cargo from them. However, as the goods were being off-loaded, I-5YQ deliberately dropped a crate onto Cleben's [[Limb/Legends|foot]] in order to create a distraction, to allow them to observe the security controls that governed access point to the Red Zone. Cleben howled out in pain and he was subsequently carried to the infirmary by some of his men.
